name: Explosion Bear
description: An invisible rune causes the animated bear to explode if it is destroyed or if it finishes its dance while anyone is in the room.
disable: DC 48 Thievery check (legendary) to erase the rune without triggering the explosion (the DC is increased to DC 51 Thievery check while the bear is moving), Dispel Magic (10th rank, counteract DC 39) to counteract the rune, or Nyrissa says the words "Good bear" to the trap before it finishes its dance.

offensiveAbilities.name: Fireball
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The animated bear is reduced below its BT, or it finishes its three-round dance while there are still people in the room

Effect The rune detonates into a blast of fire centered on the bear. All creatures within a 20-foot radius of the center of area K6 take 16d10 fire damage (DC 42 basic Reflex save).
